what_differs: On 2026-09-30 the team decided that each redeposit allocation stores start/end dates for eligible signups, set by ops and pre-populated from a default on the deal, and that reps can select only players with signups in that range. WAGR-464 says only 'A BA assigns slots to eligible players'; no ticket states the date-range rule or the deal default.
suggested_action: Suggestion: add the eligibility date-range rule (allocation-level start/end, deal default, player picker filter) to WAGR-464 and to the allocation build story.
